features.description: docs/plans/2026-10-19-P1-notifications.md fixes where structured notifications live (lib/notify.sh sourced by driver.sh and debrief.sh, pure helpers in lib/notify.mjs), the tests/stub-curl.sh contract, and the exact ntfy headers and env variables, so P1-02..04 build the same thing.
steps: docs/plans/2026-10-19-P1-notifications.md exists and starts with 'Milestone base: <sha>' where <sha> is `git rev-parse HEAD` at the start of this session (the P1 review diffs from it)

the plan names the function signature of notify (message, then fields: title, body, click, actions, priority, tags) and the five HARNESS_NOTIFY_* variables from the spec P1.1, and says $1 to NOTIFY_CMD stays '[<run>] <message>'

the plan names tests/stub-curl.sh and its record format: one block per call in $STUB_DIR/curl.log, every argument on its own line, blocks separated by a line '==='; and the fixture tests/fixtures/ntfy-publish.txt that copies the ntfy publish request shape (headers Title, Priority, Tags, Click, Actions, Authorization) from docs.ntfy.sh with the source URL in its first line

the plan lists the pure helpers of lib/notify.mjs with their signatures: githubUrls(originUrl, branch, path) -> {blob, edit} | null; trimBody(text, cap=3500) -> text ending in '…' when cut; actionsHeader([{label,url}]) -> 'view, <label>, <url>; …'; inboxQuestion(before, after) -> the lines added above '## Answers'

the plan lists every notify call site in lib/driver.sh and lib/debrief.sh with the title, priority and click URL each will get (P1.3 and P1.4 of the spec), and the config defaults to add to lib/config.sh: NTFY_URL='' NTFY_TOKEN='' DESK_URL=''

the plan lists the checks to add to tests/run.sh for P1-02, P1-03 and P1-04 by name, including the url.<local>.insteadOf trick: the throwaway project gets `git config url.$T/origin.git.insteadOf git@github.com:test/proj.git` and `remote.origin.url` = git@github.com:test/proj.git, so pushes stay local while URL derivation (which reads `git config --get remote.origin.url`) sees a GitHub origin
bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing

features.description: notify takes a message plus optional title, body, click, actions, priority and tags; with NTFY_URL set the harness posts to ntfy itself through ${HARNESS_CURL:-curl} (NOTIFY_CMD then not called), otherwise NOTIFY_CMD gets $1 unchanged plus the fields as HARNESS_NOTIFY_* variables; the body is capped at 3500 bytes; NTFY_TOKEN goes as a bearer header and is never logged.
steps: tests/stub-curl.sh exists, is executable, and appends one block per call to $STUB_DIR/curl.log (each argument on its own line, blocks separated by '==='); tests/run.sh exports HARNESS_CURL=$HERE/stub-curl.sh; tests/fixtures/ntfy-publish.txt exists with the docs.ntfy.sh source URL on its first line
lib/notify.sh exists with a one-line usage header, passes bash -n, and is sourced by lib/driver.sh and lib/debrief.sh (grep -n 'notify.sh' lib/driver.sh lib/debrief.sh shows one source line each)

node --input-type=module -e 'import {trimBody} from "./lib/notify.mjs"; const t=trimBody("x".repeat(4000)); if (Buffer.byteLength(t) > 3500 || !t.endsWith("…")) process.exit(1)' exits 0, and trimBody of a 100-byte text returns it unchanged

tests/run.sh check 'NOTIFY_CMD-only: $1 unchanged, fields as env': with NOTIFY_CMD set to a command that appends "$1" and env | grep ^HARNESS_NOTIFY_ to a file, a run's 'started:' notification shows $1 = '[<run>] started: …' and HARNESS_NOTIFY_TITLE set

tests/run.sh check 'NTFY_URL: curl posts the fields as headers, NOTIFY_CMD not called': with NTFY_URL=https://ntfy.example/t and NOTIFY_CMD both set in the user config, a run's 'started:' notification appears in curl.log as a block containing the URL, -H lines 'Title: …' and 'Priority: …' (or the fields the plan fixed), and the message as the request body; the NOTIFY_CMD file is not written

tests/run.sh check 'NTFY_TOKEN: bearer header sent, never logged': with NTFY_TOKEN=tok-secret-123, curl.log contains 'Authorization: Bearer tok-secret-123' and grep -r tok-secret-123 over the run's state dir (run.log) and run record (harness-log.md) finds nothing
tests/run.sh check 'a body over the cap is trimmed': a notification whose body is 4000 bytes reaches curl.log with a body of at most 3500 bytes ending in '…'
a failed post (stub curl exits 22 when STUB_CURL_FAIL=1) is noted in harness-log.md as 'notification failed (curl exit 22): <title>' and the run goes on; a successful post is a line in run.log only
bash -n lib/notify.sh lib/driver.sh lib/debrief.sh and node --check lib/notify.mjs pass; bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing

features.description: A park sends '[<run>] <feature> needs you' at priority high with tag question, a body made of the PARKED line, the lines the session added to INBOX.md and the answer command, a click URL to INBOX.md on the run branch on GitHub, and Edit INBOX / Answer with Claude (DESK_URL) / Progress actions; a non-GitHub origin sends the same without URLs.
steps: node --input-type=module -e 'import {githubUrls as g} from "./lib/notify.mjs"; const a=g("git@github.com:o/r.git","harness/x",".harness/runs/x/INBOX.md"), b=g("https://github.com/o/r.git","harness/x","p"), c=g("https://github.com/o/r","harness/x","p"), d=g("/tmp/origin.git","harness/x","p"); process.exit(a.blob==="https://github.com/o/r/blob/harness/x/.harness/runs/x/INBOX.md" && a.edit==="https://github.com/o/r/edit/harness/x/.harness/runs/x/INBOX.md" && b.blob.startsWith("https://github.com/o/r/blob/") && c.blob===b.blob && d===null ? 0 : 1)' exits 0

node --input-type=module -e 'import {inboxQuestion as q} from "./lib/notify.mjs"; const b="status: run

## Answers
", a="status: run
### B: set the gatus vars, then answer

## Answers
"; process.exit(q(b,a).trim()==="### B: set the gatus vars, then answer" && q(b,b)==="" ? 0 : 1)' exits 0

lib/driver.sh copies INBOX.md to $STATE/inbox-before.md before every coding session (grep -n inbox-before lib/driver.sh), and the park branch builds the body as: the PARKED line, the lines added above '## Answers' (fallback: the PARKED line alone), then 'Answer: harness answer <run> "…"'

tests/run.sh: the parky project (run 16) gets a GitHub-shaped origin via url.<local>.insteadOf before `harness start`, and the check 'a park notification: title, question, answer command, click and Edit INBOX action' finds in curl.log a block with 'Title: [parky] B needs you', 'Priority: high', 'Tags: question', a body containing 'set the gatus vars, then answer' and 'harness answer parky', 'Click: https://github.com/test/proj/blob/harness/parky/.harness/runs/parky/INBOX.md' and an Actions header containing 'view, Edit INBOX, https://github.com/test/proj/edit/harness/parky/.harness/runs/parky/INBOX.md' and 'view, Progress, https://github.com/test/proj/blob/harness/parky/.harness/runs/parky/progress.md'

tests/run.sh check 'Answer with Claude only when DESK_URL is set': with DESK_URL=https://claude.ai/code/env-test in the user config the parky Actions header contains 'view, Answer with Claude, https://claude.ai/code/env-test'; a second parked run without DESK_URL has no 'Answer with Claude' action
tests/run.sh check 'no URLs for a non-GitHub origin': a park in a project whose remote.origin.url is the local bare path produces a block with the title and body but no Click and no Actions header
lib/config.sh defaults DESK_URL='' and the three new settings appear in the harness_config defaults line (grep -n 'NTFY_URL\|DESK_URL' lib/config.sh)
bash -n lib/driver.sh lib/notify.sh, node --check lib/notify.mjs; bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing

tests/run.sh check 'a refused merge: priority high, click = the PR': run 10 (later) has a block with 'needs Michael: merge refused', 'Priority: high' and 'Click: https://example.test/pr/1'

tests/run.sh check 'verify needs Michael: priority high, click = progress.md': run 3 (strict) has a block with 'M1 needs Michael', 'Priority: high' and a Click URL ending in '/progress.md' when the origin is GitHub-shaped (or no Click for the local origin, whichever that run uses; the check says which)

lib/debrief.sh's tell() uses the shared notify so '[debrief] refused' and the headline still reach NOTIFY_CMD as before (the existing debrief checks stay green) and go to NTFY_URL when set (one check: with NTFY_URL set, a debrief's headline is a curl.log block whose Click is the note's debrief.html path only if it is a URL, else no Click)

features.description: docs/plans/2026-10-19-P3-desk.md fixes lib/desk.sh's design (tmux session, window naming, the URL wait, the input protocol, state files under <state>/desk/), the interactive mode of tests/stub-claude.sh, the test-only overrides (HARNESS_DESK_SESSION, HARNESS_DESK_WAIT) and the driver's trigger points.
steps: docs/plans/2026-10-19-P3-desk.md exists and starts with 'Milestone base: <sha>' (git rev-parse HEAD at the start of this session)

the plan gives the exact tmux commands: new-session -d -s ${HARNESS_DESK_SESSION:-h-desk} -n <run> -c <project dir> running `claude --remote-control "desk · <run> · <why>" --model <id> --add-dir <worktree>`; the URL wait as a loop over `tmux capture-pane -p` matching https://claude.ai/code/session_[A-Za-z0-9]+ up to ${HARNESS_DESK_WAIT:-60} s; input as `tmux send-keys -t <session>:<window> -l "<text>"` then `send-keys … Enter`; and that a run's window is reused when it exists and its pane's claude is alive (tmux list-panes -F '#{pane_dead}' or the pane pid)

the plan lists the driver's trigger points with the --why text each passes (park: '<id> parked: <why>'; run end blocked/waiting; verify needs Michael; merge refused/conflict) and that each is `[[ $DESK == 1 ]] && desk … || note …` so a failing desk never changes the run's course; and lib/config.sh defaults DESK=0 DESK_MODEL=opus

features.description: `harness desk <run> [--why "<one line>"]` writes a desk prompt from prompts/desk.md to <state>/desk/<stamp>.md, starts tmux window <run> in the desk session running claude with Remote Control in the project directory (--add-dir the worktree), waits for the session URL in the pane, sends 'Read <prompt> and follow it.', notifies with click = the URL, keeps the URL in <state>/desk/url and prints it; tests drive it with the stub claude's interactive mode in a throwaway tmux session.
steps: tests/stub-claude.sh without -p prints the line from tests/fixtures/remote-control-pane.txt (its first line names the source: the pane of claude 2.1.303 on 2026-10-19) with session_TEST<n>, then appends each stdin line to $STUB_DIR/desk/<name>.in; tests/run.sh exports HARNESS_DESK_SESSION=h-desk-test-$$ and its EXIT trap runs `tmux kill-session -t $HARNESS_DESK_SESSION`

features.description: Housekeeping: `harness desk --list` prints window, run, URL and age; `harness desk --close <run>|--all` kills desk windows; `harness gc <project>` closes desks whose last event is older than 24 h.
steps: tests/run.sh check 'harness desk --list': after the P3-02..04 desks exist, the output has one line per window with the window name, the run id, the https://claude.ai/code/session_TEST… URL and an age like '0 min' (a window without a URL shows '-')

features.description: An Opus reviewer reads the P3 diff from a file, fixes Critical and Important findings test-first (tmux leaks, a desk that could stop a run, secrets in prompts), applies simplifications, and updates docs/architecture.md, README.md, templates/user/config.sh and journal/decisions.md (D-H31).
steps: git diff <Milestone base from docs/plans/2026-10-19-P3-desk.md>..HEAD -- lib bin tests prompts templates > /tmp/p3.diff was written and read; docs/plans/2026-10-19-P3-review.md lists each finding with severity, file:line and resolution, and explicitly answers: can any path start a real claude from tests (must be no), can a desk failure change a run's end reason (must be no), does any prompt or log carry NTFY_TOKEN (must be no)
every Critical and Important finding has a check in tests/run.sh that was red before its fix (named in the review file)

journal/decisions.md has '### D-H31' for the self-starting desk: finding · choice (claude --remote-control in a tmux window, the pane URL as the click, one desk per run, DESK=0 until tried) · rejected (claude remote-control server mode; answers through ntfy)

docs/architecture.md §3 lists lib/desk.sh and prompts/desk.md, §4 lists <state>/desk/ and queue/desk/, §7 Guards has 'a desk failing to start never stops or fails the run', §10 lists DESK, DESK_MODEL, DESK_URL, and the Answer desk section describes the self-starting path; the components table's check count matches tests/run.sh

README.md Steering describes the desk (what Michael sees on the phone, DESK=1 to turn it on, `harness desk --list|--close`), and templates/user/config.sh has DESK and DESK_MODEL; the Tests line's check count matches

docs/plans/2026-10-19-P3-desk.md ends with a 'For Michael: turning it on' section: the exact commands in stages (DESK=0 by hand `harness desk <run> --why test` once → DESK=1 for one night → always), what to check after each stage (the phone opens the session; the brief reads the INBOX; the answer lands), and how to undo (DESK=0; `harness desk --all`)
bash -n on every .sh touched in P3 and node --check on every .mjs pass; bash tests/run.sh ends with every check passing
